scripts.format: gofmt -w $(git ls-files '*.go') && oxfmt package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml orval.config.ts docs/openapi.yaml packages/cli/package.json packages/web tools/build
scripts.format:check: test -z "$(gofmt -l $(git ls-files '*.go'))" && oxfmt --check package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml orval.config.ts docs/openapi.yaml packages/cli/package.json packages/web tools/build
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter @tokeninsights/cli run lint && oxlint orval.config.ts packages/web tools/build
scripts.generate:api:go: cd packages/cli && go tool oapi-codegen -config internal/server/api/oapi-codegen.yaml ../../docs/openapi.yaml
scripts.generate:api: pnpm run generate:api:go && pnpm run generate:api:web
scripts.check-web: pnpm run build:web && pnpm --filter @tokeninsights/build-tools run check:web
scripts.build:cli: pnpm run build:web && pnpm --filter @tokeninsights/cli run build
scripts.dev:data: pnpm run build:cli && pnpm --filter @tokeninsights/build-tools run setup-dev-data
scripts.install:cli: pnpm run build:web && cd packages/cli && go install ./cmd/tokeninsights
scripts.build: pnpm run check-schema && pnpm run check-api && pnpm run build:cli
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @tokeninsights/build-tools run typecheck && pnpm --filter @tokeninsights/build-tools run test && pnpm --filter @tokeninsights/web run test && pnpm --filter @tokeninsights/cli run test
